title: stelis angelica
intro: Stelis angelica, commonly known as the "Angel's Trumpet," is a type of flowering plant in the Apocynaceae family. This plant is known for its trumpet-shaped flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. Stelis angelica is reported to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful for treating various health conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Stelis angelica include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including sedative, anti-spasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
